title: Claude Code Hooks Configuration
description: Schema for hooks.json configuration files (event set current to August 2026)

hooks.description: Map of event name to an array of matcher groups. Each matcher group pairs a matcher with a nested `hooks` array of handlers.

matcherGroup.description: A matcher paired with the handlers that run when it matches.

matcher.description: Tool-name matcher. A bare tool name ('Bash'), a '|'- or ','-separated list ('Edit|Write'), '*'/'' for all, or a JavaScript regular expression when it contains any other character ('^Notebook'). NOT an expression: 'tool == "Bash"' is treated as a regex and will not match. Scope to inputs with a handler-level `if` instead.

hooks.description: Handlers that run when the matcher matches.

type.description: Handler type. command: run a shell command (stdin JSON, exit 2 blocks, exit 0 may emit JSON output such as systemMessage). http: POST the event JSON to a URL. mcp_tool: call a tool on a connected MCP server. prompt: single-turn model yes/no decision. agent: spawn a subagent to decide (experimental).

command.description: Shell command for type: command (or the executable when `args` is set).

args.description: Argument vector; when present, `command` is spawned directly with no shell.

if.description: Permission-rule syntax filtering when the handler runs, e.g. 'Bash(git push *)' or 'Edit(*.ts)'. Only evaluated on tool events.

async.description: Run in the background without blocking.

asyncRewake.description: Run in the background and wake Claude on exit code 2. Implies async.

statusMessage.description: Spinner message shown while the handler runs.

shell.description: Shell for the command. Ignored when `args` is set.

once.description: Run once per session then remove. Honored only in skill/agent frontmatter, ignored in settings files.
